name: Gawara the United
bio: Gawara was once two brothers: one pure of heart, one tainted by evil, both afflicted by the same curse. The Blades of Duality provided the only cure, fusing the two into a single, two-headed being. Their fusion led to a lot of intense arguing, which soon lead to intense internal reflection. Gawara is now much calmer – a requirement to fight the Demons and Cambion who rather they didn't exist.
